title: The moved findings gate is unreachable for a zero-commit close-out, which only the recorded no-commits rule currently makes impossible
body: gateCloseoutClose (and therefore the aqm findings hold) runs only in the integrated path, i.e. for a close-out attempt with commits. A closeout-epic that collects zero commits would go through closeRoleTick, which no longer has any findings gate; today the recorded no-commits rule refuses such a collect (RefusedCollect) before any close, so the shape is unreachable. If that role rule is ever relaxed, the epic could hand over with untriaged findings and no hold. A guard test or a gate call in closeRoleTick guarded on marker.Role == closeout-epic would close the latent gap.
